title: Punjab AAP Minister Arora in ED Grip Over Rs 100-Cr GST Scam
excerpt: A Gurugram court grants 7-day custody to probe alleged fake invoices, shell firms, and Dubai round-tripping scheme
body:
Punjab Cabinet Minister Sanjeev Arora — one of the most powerful figures in the Bhagwant Mann government — now sits in Enforcement Directorate custody after a special PMLA court in Gurugram found the charges against him 'very serious.' The ED arrested the 62-year-old AAP leader from his official Chandigarh residence on May 9, 2026, and produced him before the court late that night.

**What the ED alleges:**
Investigators claim Arora ran a large-scale laundering operation through Hampton Sky Realty Ltd (HSRL), a Gurugram firm in which he served as Chairman and Managing Director. The agency says HSRL procured mobile phones using fake invoices from shell firms — entities that were either non-existent or had negligible financial capacity — to fraudulently claim Input Tax Credit worth over Rs 100 crore. Proceeds were allegedly exported to two Dubai-based firms and round-tripped back to India to legitimise illicit gains.

**The political charge:**
Arora's lawyer fired back immediately, saying 'the ED registered the case on May 5 and arrested him on May 9 — this is politically motivated and orchestrated.' AAP chief Arvind Kejriwal and Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann both condemned the arrest, calling it a misuse of central agencies ahead of the February 2027 Punjab elections. Hampton Sky Realty also denied wrongdoing, insisting its exports were genuine and verified by customs, banking channels, and even Apple Inc. The BJP, meanwhile, declared AAP's 'so-called honesty exposed.'

**What to watch:**
The court has set May 16 as the next date of appearance — watch for whether the ED seeks an extension of custody or files for attachment of Arora's assets under PMLA.
nri_angle: For Indian-Americans with family roots in Punjab — and especially those invested in the state's business and industrial climate — Arora's arrest signals deepening political turbulence in the run-up to the 2027 Punjab elections, with real consequences for investor confidence in the AAP government.
author: Diaspora Desk
